financials_multi_year.source: PGE FY2025 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements (WSE), read 26-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 recurring EBITDA reached record PLN 12.9bn; net economic debt fell to PLN 4.2bn (reported net debt/EBITDA 1.23x); net loss -PLN 3.4bn from non-cash generation write-downs.
9M26 rev PLN 48.57bn, net profit swung to +PLN 7.04bn aided by one-off reclamation provision release and solid gas/heat/grid earnings.

recovery_analysis.thesis: PGE posted 9M26 revenue of PLN 48.57bn and swung to a PLN 7.04bn net profit following FY25's record PLN 12.9bn recurring EBITDA and 1.23x leverage. Fitch (BBB Stable) and Moody's (Baa1 Stable) balance strong grid/heat cash flows against multi-billion PLN offshore wind capex. Structural recovery anchored by Poland utilities asset perimeter and PGE 5.125% 2029 seniority.

annotations.note: FY25 recurring EBITDA PLN 12.9bn, net lev 1.23x; 9M26 rev PLN 48.57bn, NPAT PLN 7.04bn.
Q326 headline EBITDA PLN 4.61bn (recurring ~PLN 2.89bn), NPAT PLN 3.0bn; Fitch affirmed BBB Stable (Sep-26) and Moody's confirmed Baa1 Stable (Jul-26).
Revenues secured by long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or regulated tariff frameworks, providing hard-currency indexation and guaranteed minimum volume off-take.
Heavy generation transition capex peaks in 2024-2025; multi-year FCF inflects strongly positive as commercial operations commence.
Strategic national utility champions benefit from government balancing accounts or explicit fuel supply guarantees, mitigating commodity price volatility.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Low-Leverage Polish Utility with Offshore Capex Ramp (BBB / Baa1)
verdict.summary: PGE posted 9M26 revenue of PLN 48.57bn and swung to a PLN 7.04bn net profit following FY25's record PLN 12.9bn recurring EBITDA and 1.23x leverage. Fitch (BBB Stable) and Moody's (Baa1 Stable) balance strong grid/heat cash flows against multi-billion PLN offshore wind capex.

positives: Strong IG ratings: Fitch BBB Stable (Sep-26) and Moody's Baa1 Stable (Jul-26), anchored by ~61% Polish state ownership.
Regulated electricity distribution & capacity market payments cushion generation cyclicality.
Q3 2026 recurring EBITDA ~PLN 2.89bn beat consensus; EUR 2bn EMTN programme supports funding.
negatives: Fitch flags heavy capex toward distribution grids, gas CCGTs, and Baltic offshore wind driving negative FCF over medium term.
Legacy coal/lignite generation assets (Bełchatów, Turów) weigh on ESG profile pending coal spin-off/phase-out.

background.business_overview: Poland's largest integrated power utility across distribution, conventional/renewable generation, district heating, and retail supply.
background.asset_perimeter: Distribution grid (PGE Dystrybucja), coal/gas/wind power plants, Baltic offshore wind JVs; €2bn EMTN via PGE Sweden AB.
background.ownership_governance: ~60.86% owned by the Polish State Treasury; WSE-listed.

recent_drivers: Nov-26 (Q326 est): Headline EBITDA PLN 4.61bn (recurring PLN 2.89bn), attributable net profit PLN 3.0bn.
Jul/Sep-26: Moody's confirmed Baa1 Stable (Jul-26); Fitch affirmed BBB Stable (Sep-26), flagging negative FCF from transition capex.
